coverage: Factory IO is visible while pending and consumes no CPU lease. Native work waits behind an occupied CPU, then owns CPU1 until its pointers are freed.
Cancellation while the factory is unresolved preserves activity and heap accounting until settlement. Abort/dispose while queued retire only this request; native failure frees pointers and CPU.

The real native embedding kernel is invoked through the production preparation wrapper. Its output bytes match a direct invocation of the same unchanged native kernel; this is wrapper parity, not an additional external scientific oracle.
CAT-Net inherits admission with its own explicit resource owner. Every test finishes with zero tracked operations and budget.
limits: No browser, 96 MP calculation, calibration, capacity probe, numerical change or worker/memory limit change.
CPU admission is a scheduler guarantee, not a measurement of physical CPU usage. Native compilation/initialization is visible IO without holding an application CPU slot.
